findings.detail: An additional investment schedule with its own Total Investments fair value of 267.327 million appears to have been included in the extracted position sum even though the issuer-level filing total is 2.064194 billion.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate check. The source totals agree with the companyfacts anchor: table 24 row 8 and table 47 row 19 both report total investments at fair value of 2,064,194 thousand, matching the companyfacts_fv anchor of 2,064,194,000. The extracted position sum is 2,345,309,000, an overshoot of 281,115,000, so the conservation flag is a real data error rather than a bad anchor. The extra schedule total at table 78 row 45 localizes a substantial out-of-scope lookthrough component, but it does not exactly equal the full residual, so localization remains partial.
